a.lede: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.
a.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch

b.lede: OpenAI is responding to Meta's buzzy Muse AI with agentic helpers of its own: Dots.
